I built a shoe rack in a style I don’t usually design AND IT WORKS!  Brought to us by Squarespace. For 10% off your first purchase, go to: http://squarespace.com/makesomething

Hardwood from Kencraft: https://goo.gl/pCyB95

Patreon members get project files, early and ad-free videos, my custom finish, behind the scenes videos, as well as access to our private Discord: https://www.patreon.com/picciuto

This lake house came with a shoe rack that never felt like it belonged. Instead of replacing it with another cheap solution, I decided to design something that fit the space—even though it pushed me outside my usual style. This is a simple, durable shoe rack built for a rental house, with a small artistic detail added just to keep things interesting. It’s a project about adapting your design instincts, listening to a space, and finding creativity in constraints.
